summary: EF Protocol 集群发布 Hegotá 分级榜，对 62 个提案 EIP 统一评级，FOCIL 和 frame 交易（EIP-8141）为 S 级必发，keyed nonce、recent roots 等为 A 级。EIP-8272 合并改动，把 recent root 验证帧的执行 gas 计入 `MAX_VERIFY_GAS`。EIP-8037 修复顶层回滚时把预执行状态 gas 错误退回的问题。misilva73 发帖梳理 Hegotá 的 10 多个重定价 EIP。

items.title: EF Protocol 集群发布两篇文章
items.note: 21:57：Hegotá EIP 观点与分级榜 和 当前与新兴优先事项。约 60 人、16 份意见，对 62 个 EIP 给出 397 个评级（S=4 到 D=0）。EIP-8141 被称为“锁定的 EL 头条”，理由是安全：无需每种方案都分叉就能走向 PQ 签名、可聚合以合理定价 PQ 验证、并逐步淘汰 k1 密钥，与 EIP-8250、EIP-8272 一起发布。FOCIL 为锁定的 CL 头条，应与 EIP-8369 一起发布。
items.title_en: The EF Protocol cluster published two posts
items.note_en: 21:57: the Hegotá EIP opinion post and tier list and current and emerging priorities. About 60 people and 16 contributions produced 397 grades across 62 EIPs (S = 4 down to D = 0). EIP-8141 is called the "locked-in EL headliner" on security grounds: a path to PQ signature schemes without a fork per scheme, aggregation so PQ verification can be priced, and a route to retiring k1 keys; it ships with EIP-8250 and EIP-8272. FOCIL is the locked-in CL headliner and should ship with EIP-8369.

items.topic: frame 交易的验证与状态 gas 细节
items.title: EIP-8272：计入 recent root 验证 gas
items.note: （soispoke）合并。此前验证帧不计入 EIP-8141 的 `MAX_VERIFY_GAS`，现在它的 `limits.execution` 与签名验证和验证前缀里其他帧一起计入同一上限，不新增额度。
items.title_en: EIP-8272: count recent root verification gas
items.note_en: (soispoke) was merged. The verifier frame was excluded from EIP-8141's `MAX_VERIFY_GAS`; now its `limits.execution` counts toward the same cap as signature verification and the other frames in the validation prefix, with no separate allowance.
items.topic_en: Validation and state gas details for frame transactions

items.topic: frame 交易的验证与状态 gas 细节
items.title: EIP-8037：预执行状态 gas 不参与帧回滚
items.note: （chfast，9 月 14 日合并）。上周的回滚修复只覆盖储备，顶层回滚会把预执行收费退回 `gas_left`，而它付费的状态仍然写入；例如一笔带一个 EIP-7702 授权的交易，整笔 `STATE_BYTES_PER_AUTH_BASE` 被退回但委托仍生效。
items.title_en: EIP-8037: keep pre-execution state gas out of the frame rollback
items.note_en: (chfast, merged September 14). Last week's rollback fix covered only the reservoir, so a top-level rollback credited a pre-execution charge back to `gas_left` while the state it paid for stayed written; for a transaction with one EIP-7702 authorization the whole `STATE_BYTES_PER_AUTH_BASE` charge was refilled though the delegation stayed applied.

keywords_en: FOCIL and frame transactions in S tier
EIP-8272 verification gas counted toward the cap
summary_en: The EF Protocol cluster published its Hegotá tier list, grading all 62 proposed EIPs in one view: FOCIL and frame transactions (EIP-8141) are S tier, must ship, and keyed nonces, recent roots and others are A tier. EIP-8272 merged a change counting the recent root verifier frame's execution gas toward `MAX_VERIFY_GAS`. EIP-8037 fixed top-level rollbacks wrongly refunding pre-execution state gas. misilva73 posted an overview of Hegotá's 10+ repricing EIPs.
